states.label: Deflect the defender
states.description: Draw a defender away by exchanging or offering a piece, then exploit the duty it abandons: a loose target, a fork square, a mating square, or a pawn blockade. Continue only when the resulting board supports the capture, checking fork, mate attack or promotion. Examine the listed recaptures and forcing counters, and settle the exchange before claiming its material goal. King acceptance and direct attacks on a passed pawn are explicit selective reply priorities.

proof.scope: Selective human tactical investigation. Each current card chooses moves, replies and continuations from chess predicates. Some cards examine every legal check evasion; others explicitly prioritize a king capture, safe forcing counters, queen escapes or concrete mate defenses. Claims cover those generated replies and the stated material or positional goal.
proof.quiet_definition: Completion uses the current card's explicit board conditions. A material goal may survive an available takeback; pawn-gain, queenless-advantage, exposed-king and repaired-piece goals have their own conditions. The absence of a generated reply does not assert that all legal moves are equivalent.

positional_objectives.BREAK_KING_SHELTER: From equal material, expose the opposing king without falling behind in material. This proves the declared board transformation only; it does not by itself prove forced mate or an eventual material win.
